name: @cr/image-hygiene
description: Gabe. Dependency-free image metadata stripping over raw bytes: drops EXIF/GPS, XMP, IPTC, ICC and text chunks from JPEG/PNG/WebP while leaving the encoded picture byte-identical. Shared by the browser (strip before the presigned PUT) and the Lambda (strip again on ingest) so a student photo's geolocation never rests in storage.
